title: Vietnam Location Guidebook
bodyHtml:
Vietnam Filming Location Guide

Download our Vietnam Location Guide, a curated production resource designed for international agencies, producers, and commercial film teams planning shoots across the country. This guide highlights diverse filming locations in Vietnam — from modern cityscapes and industrial zones to tropical coastlines, mountain landscapes, and remote natural environments — helping you evaluate creative possibilities before your production begins.

Created by the team at Vantage Pictures, the guide reflects real-world production experience supporting global commercial shoots throughout Vietnam.

title: Home
bodyHtml:
A Bit of Our Work

Global Commercial Film Production for Ambitious Brands

Vantage Pictures is a globally operating commercial film production company creating cinematic brand films, product launch campaigns, and high-impact technology commercials for ambitious companies worldwide. We collaborate with fast-growing innovators and established global brands to craft visually refined, strategically grounded films that elevate product storytelling and brand identity.

A core specialty of our studio is helping Asian technology brands — particularly from China — connect with Western audiences through premium, internationally positioned campaigns. From robotics and AI to consumer electronics and next-generation hardware, we translate complex innovation into emotionally resonant visual storytelling.

Beyond technology, our portfolio spans lifestyle, automotive, energy, sport, and documentary-driven brand films — all executed with disciplined production standards, cinematic craft, and cross-border expertise.

Brands We Work With
bodyHtmlZh:
精选作品

面向全球品牌的商业影像制作

Vantage Pictures 是一家面向全球市场的商业影像制作公司，专注于品牌影片、产品发布广告以及科技类商业广告制作。我们与快速成长的创新企业和成熟的全球品牌合作，通过视觉精致、策略清晰的影片提升品牌故事与产品价值。

我们的核心优势之一，是帮助亚洲科技品牌（尤其是中国企业）通过国际化水准的广告影片，与欧美市场建立更有效的沟通。

除了科技领域，我们的作品还涵盖生活方式、汽车、能源、体育以及纪录片风格的品牌影片。所有项目均以严谨的制作标准、电影级视觉语言以及跨境制作经验完成。

title: About
bodyHtml:
Who We Are

Vantage Pictures is a global commercial film production company creating cinematic brand films, product launch campaigns, and technology-driven advertising for ambitious brands worldwide. While our studio operates internationally, we have developed a strong specialization in helping Asian technology companies — particularly from China — position their products for Western audiences through premium, internationally competitive campaigns.

Our team combines strategic messaging, disciplined production execution, and refined cinematic craft across industries including AI and robotics, consumer electronics, automotive, energy, lifestyle, and documentary-driven brand storytelling. With extensive cross-border experience, we bridge markets, cultures, and creative standards to deliver work that performs globally.

Our Team
bodyHtmlZh:
我们是谁

Vantage Pictures 是一家全球性商业电影制作公司，为全球雄心勃勃的品牌制作电影品牌宣传片、产品发布活动和技术驱动型广告。虽然我们的工作室在全球范围内开展业务，但我们在帮助亚洲科技公司（尤其是来自中国的公司）通过具有国际竞争力的优质宣传活动为西方受众定位其产品方面形成了强大的专业优势。

我们的团队将战略性信息传递、严谨的制作执行和精湛的电影制作工艺结合在一起，涉及的行业包括人工智能和机器人、消费电子、汽车、能源、生活方式和纪录片驱动的品牌故事。凭借丰富的跨国经验，我们在市场、文化和创意标准之间架起了一座桥梁，在全球范围内完成作品。

title: Vietnam Production Service
bodyHtml:
Vietnam Production Service for International Commercial Shoots

Vantage Pictures provides full-service Vietnam production support for international brands, agencies, and production companies shooting commercials, brand films, documentaries, and product campaigns across the country. With extensive experience servicing global clients, we deliver reliable local execution with international production standards.

Why Film in Vietnam?

Vietnam offers diverse landscapes, competitive production costs, skilled local crews, and streamlined logistics for international commercial shoots. From modern cityscapes in Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi to tropical coastlines, mountain ranges, and industrial environments, Vietnam provides a wide range of visually distinctive locations within close geographic proximity.

Full-Service Production Support in Vietnam

Our Vietnam production services cover every stage of the filmmaking process, including location scouting, permitting, casting, crew sourcing, equipment rental, production management, line producing, budgeting, and post-production coordination. Whether servicing large-scale commercial productions or agile documentary crews, we ensure efficient execution, clear communication, and professional oversight throughout.

Filming Locations Across Vietnam

Our Vietnam production services cover every stage of the filmmaking process, including location scouting, permitting, casting, crew sourcing, equipment rental, production management, line producing, budgeting, and post-production coordination. Whether servicing large-scale commercial productions or agile documentary crews, we ensure efficient execution, clear communication, and professional oversight throughout.

Trusted by Global Brands and Agencies

We regularly collaborate with international creative teams from Asia, Europe, and North America, supporting cross-border productions with bilingual production management and transparent budgeting. Our experience working with technology brands, consumer electronics companies, and global marketing agencies ensures smooth integration between local Vietnamese crews and international stakeholders.

Shot in Vietnam

Plan Your Next Production in Vietnam

If you are planning a commercial shoot, brand film, or documentary in Vietnam, contact Vantage Pictures to discuss your project requirements. Our team will provide detailed production guidance, budgeting support, and on-the-ground expertise tailored to your timeline and objectives.
bodyHtmlZh:
越南制作服务 用于国际商业拍摄

Vantage Pictures 为国际品牌、代理商和制作公司在越南全国各地拍摄广告、品牌影片、纪录片和产品宣传片提供全方位的制作支持服务。凭借为全球客户服务的丰富经验，我们以国际制作标准提供可靠的本地执行服务。

为什么要在越南拍摄电影？

越南为国际商业拍摄提供了多样的景观、具有竞争力的制作成本、熟练的当地工作人员和简化的物流。从胡志明市和河内的现代城市景观，到热带海岸线、山脉和工业环境，越南在地理位置上近在咫尺，提供了大量视觉上独具特色的拍摄地点。

全方位制作支持服务 在越南

我们在越南提供的制作服务涵盖电影制作过程的每一个阶段，包括勘景、许可、选角、寻找工作人员、设备租赁、制作管理、制片流程、预算编制和后期制作协调。无论是为大型商业制作提供服务，还是为灵活的纪录片摄制组提供服务，我们都能确保高效的执行、清晰的沟通以及全程的专业监督。

拍摄地点 横跨越南

我们在越南提供的制作服务涵盖电影制作过程的每一个阶段，包括勘景、许可、选角、寻找工作人员、设备租赁、制作管理、制片流程、预算编制和后期制作协调。无论是为大型商业制作提供服务，还是为灵活的纪录片摄制组提供服务，我们都能确保高效的执行、清晰的沟通以及全程的专业监督。

值得信赖 全球品牌和代理商

我们经常与来自亚洲、欧洲和北美的国际创意团队合作，通过双语制作管理和透明的预算编制为跨境制作提供支持。我们与科技品牌、消费电子产品公司和全球营销机构的合作经验确保了越南本地团队与国际利益相关者之间的顺利融合。

在越南拍摄

计划下一次制作 在越南

如果您计划在越南拍摄商业片、品牌片或纪录片，请联系 Vantage Pictures 讨论您的项目要求。我们的团队将根据您的时间表和目标提供详细的制作指导、预算支持和实地专业知识。
